tests.name: Fresh startup never applies or recovers the old staged entry point
Legacy automatic flags and cached release state are removed without changing other preferences
Startup resume and suspend cannot schedule or request plugin updates
Settings categories and global search contain no plugin online-update entry
Obsolete update routes lead to About instead of opening a dead settings page
Overlay compatibility modules cannot connect, start workers, render update menus or install
Malformed pending and journal data is discarded without parsing or executing it
Cleanup unlinks cache symlinks without traversing outside the dedicated work directory
Settings persistence failure cannot enable the retired updater or block frontend use
Repeated cleanup is idempotent and closing the plugin makes no update request
